lines.say: Unleashed or Katana? Same shortlist. Different strengths.
lines.show: Unleashed or Katana? Same shortlist. Different strengths.

lines.say: Unleashed is inventory software first. Stock, wholesale and sales channels.
lines.show: Unleashed is inventory software first. Stock, wholesale and sales channels.

lines.say: Katana puts production at the centre. Routings, and a shop floor app for operators.
lines.show: Katana puts production at the centre. Routings, and a Shop Floor App for operators.

lines.say: In Unleashed, production is a module. It's not on the Light package.
lines.show: In Unleashed, production is a module. It's not on the Lite package.

lines.say: Unleashed has three packages. Light. Core. Or Pro. Plus paid extras.
lines.show: Unleashed has three packages. Lite, Core or Pro. Plus paid extras.

lines.say: Katana is free up to thirty skews. Then one annual price, not per user.
lines.show: Katana is free up to 30 SKUs. Then one annual price, not per user.

lines.say: Both connect to Zero and QuickBooks Online. Neither has a native My-ob connection.
lines.show: Both connect to Xero and QuickBooks Online. Neither has a native MYOB connection.

lines.say: Stock is the hard part? Unleashed. Production? Katana.
lines.show: Stock is the hard part? Unleashed. Production? Katana.
